primary_text.en:
Three times before lunch, someone on your team writes an email they have already written.

DoviLoop drafts the reply from your own fees, deadlines and policies, and leaves it in their Outlook drafts in their own words.

Nothing sends until they read it. Nothing leaves Europe.
